name: imds-ssrf
description:
A proxy capture of an exploit against an EC2-hosted preview service (`ssrf-capture.log`), plus an encrypted operator note recovered from the box (`notes.enc`).

Read what the attacker pulled out of the instance, then open the note. The flag is in it.

Stuck? Hints are available (they cost a few points).

Flag format: NCTF{...}
